name: ui-press
prompt: Short crisp UI button press: a small plastic key click with a soft electronic blip, snappy attack, very short decay, no reverb.

name: ui-back
prompt: Soft UI back-navigation click: a muted plastic tap slightly lower in pitch than a confirm click, quick and dry, no reverb tail.

name: invalid-action
prompt: Dull rejected-action thud: two low wooden knocks on a hollow console in quick succession, muted and short, conveying refusal.

name: ship-place
prompt: Heavy game piece placed on a board: a solid mechanical clunk of a metal model ship set onto a hard chart table, with a faint spring latch.

name: rotate-tick
prompt: Quick ratchet tick: a small metal dial or gear rotating one notch, single sharp mechanical click, bright and very short.

name: torpedo-fire
prompt: Torpedo launch: a pressurized burst followed by a rising whoosh of a projectile leaving a tube, airy rush building quickly then cut off.

name: splash-miss
prompt: Object plunging into open water: a full splash with initial plunge, sloshing water, and droplets settling, natural and unprocessed.

name: hull-hit
prompt: Projectile striking a steel ship hull: sharp metallic clang layered over a deep booming impact, brief ringing resonance fading out.

name: ship-sunk
prompt: Ship sinking: a heavy explosion followed by groaning metal, rushing water, and deep gurgling bubbles as the vessel goes under.

name: mine-detonation
prompt: Naval mine detonating: sudden harsh underwater explosion with a deep pressure thump, turbulent water rumble, and falling debris spray.

name: turn-chime
prompt: Soft two-tone notification chime: gentle struck glass or vibraphone notes rising, clear and polite, signaling it is your turn.

name: countdown-blip
prompt: Single countdown beep: one clean short electronic ping, round attack, medium pitch, precise and unobtrusive.

name: victory-fanfare
prompt: Short victory fanfare: bright brass and bell tones rising in a triumphant five-note flourish, celebratory, ending on a held high note.

name: defeat-motif
prompt: Somber defeat motif: low muted horn notes descending slowly, hollow and heavy, fading into a quiet low drone.

name: lesson-complete
prompt: Cheerful task-complete jingle: two bright ascending mallet notes, light and encouraging, clean short decay.

name: achievement-sparkle
prompt: Achievement sparkle: a rapid ascending glissando of tiny crystalline bell tones with a shimmering glockenspiel shimmer, light and magical.
